programs.name: sumigffd
programs.purpose: Depth-migrate zero-offset traces using Fourier finite differences and a velocity model.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUMIGFFD - Fourier finite difference depth migration for

params.name: dt
params.default: computed: header dt in seconds, or 0.004 if unset

params.name: dx
params.default: computed: header d2, or 1.0 if unset

params.name: ft
params.description: First time sample; read but not used in the migration.

params.name: fz
params.description: First depth sample; the resulting depth coordinate is not used in the migration.

params.name: vfile
params.description: Native-float velocity file, indexed as v[depth][trace].

params.name: tmpdir
params.default: computed: CWP_TMPDIR environment variable if set, otherwise empty string
params.description: Directory for named temporary files; an empty string selects tmpfile().

programs.float_sensitive_notes: FFT results, ordered frequency accumulation, complex tridiagonal solves, and mixed float and double calculations using pow, sqrt, sin and cos affect reproducibility. The finite-difference boundary code accesses indices 1 and 2 and requires at least three traces; small or singular systems can cause invalid accesses or divisions. The allocated c array in fdmig is not freed.
programs.difficulty_reason: This is a depth migration combining FFT propagation with complex finite-difference solves.

test_cases.command: sunull nt=16 ntr=16 | sugain bias=1500 | sustrip > vel.su.bin && suplane nt=128 ntr=16 dt=0.004 | sumigffd vfile=vel.su.bin nz=16 dz=10 dx=10 dt=0.004 > out.su

test_cases.description: Override sampling and first coordinates with a dipping plane.
test_cases.command: sunull nt=12 ntr=16 | sugain bias=1800 | sustrip > vel.su.bin && suplane nt=128 ntr=16 npl=1 dip1=4 dt=0.002 | sumigffd vfile=vel.su.bin nz=12 dz=8 dx=12 dt=0.002 ft=0.01 fz=5 verbose=1 > out.su

programs.name: sumiggbzo
programs.purpose: Depth-migrate zero-offset traces by tracing and accumulating Gaussian beams through an isotropic velocity model.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUMIGGBZO - MIGration via Gaussian Beams of Zero-Offset SU data

params.name: vfile
params.description: Native-float velocity model indexed as v[trace][depth].

params.name: dz
params.description: Depth spacing. Although the selfdoc gives 1.0, the earlier mandatory lookup errors when it is absent.

params.name: dt
params.default: computed: header dt in seconds, or 0.004 if unset

params.name: dx
params.default: computed: header d2, or 1.0 if unset

params.name: bwh
params.default: computed: average of the input velocities after halving, divided by fmin

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Ray integration, interpolated velocity derivatives, FFTs, beam interpolation and ordered image accumulation mix float arithmetic with transcendental functions. franuni generates live/dead cell markers; marker collisions can change behavior. Beam-center spacing can round to zero for unsuitable bwh and dx, causing division by zero.
programs.difficulty_reason: Gaussian-beam migration combines ray tracing, interpolation, FFTs and image accumulation across many beams.

test_cases.command: sunull nt=16 ntr=16 | sugain bias=1500 | sustrip > vel.bin && suplane nt=128 ntr=16 dt=0.004 | sumiggbzo vfile=vel.bin nz=16 dz=10 dx=10 dt=0.004 > out.su

test_cases.description: Use explicit beam width, frequency band and asymmetric angles.
test_cases.command: sunull nt=16 ntr=16 | sugain bias=1800 | sustrip > vel.bin && suplane nt=128 ntr=16 npl=1 dip1=4 dt=0.004 | sumiggbzo vfile=vel.bin nz=16 dz=10 dx=10 dt=0.004 fmin=8 fmax=40 amin=-30 amax=45 bwh=80 verbose=1 > out.su

programs.name: sumiggbzoan
programs.purpose: Depth-migrate zero-offset traces using Gaussian beams through an anisotropic P-wave stiffness model.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUMIGGBZOAN - MIGration via Gaussian beams ANisotropic media (P-wave)

params.name: nx
params.description: Required by the parser, but overwritten by the actual number of input traces.

params.name: dt
params.default: computed: header dt in seconds, or 0.004 if unset

params.name: dx
params.default: computed: header d2, or 1.0 if unset

params.name: a1111file
params.description: Optional a1111 model; absent, initialize it from a3333.

params.name: a1133file
params.description: Optional a1133 model; absent, initialize it to 0.4*a3333.

params.name: a1313file
params.description: Optional a1313 model; absent, initialize it to 0.3*a3333.

params.name: a1113file
params.description: Optional a1113 model; absent, initialize it to zero.

params.name: a3313file
params.description: Optional a3313 model; absent, initialize it to zero.

params.name: deltafile
params.description: Optional Thomsen delta model; absent, delta is zero when epsilon is supplied.

params.name: epsilonfile
params.description: Optional Thomsen epsilon model; absent, epsilon is zero when delta is supplied. Supplying either Thomsen file recomputes a1111 and a1133.

params.name: bwh
params.default: computed: mean of sqrt(a1111*0.25) and sqrt(a3333*0.25) over the model, divided by fmin

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Anisotropic ray integration, stiffness interpolation, square roots, FFTs and ordered beam accumulation are sensitive to floating-point evaluation and math-library behavior. franuni supplies live/dead cell markers, whose collision can affect results. Beam-center spacing can round to zero; invalid stiffness combinations can also produce invalid square roots.
programs.difficulty_reason: Anisotropic Gaussian-beam migration requires complex ray tracing, model interpolation and FFT-based beam accumulation.

test_cases.description: Use isotropic defaults for the optional stiffness files.
test_cases.command: sunull nt=16 ntr=16 | sugain bias=2250000 | sustrip > a3333.bin && suplane nt=128 ntr=16 dt=0.004 | sumiggbzoan a3333file=a3333.bin nx=16 nz=16 dz=10 dx=10 dt=0.004 > out.su

test_cases.description: Exercise the Thomsen-parameter path and explicit beam settings.
test_cases.command: sunull nt=16 ntr=16 | sugain bias=2250000 | sustrip > a3333.bin && sunull nt=16 ntr=16 | sugain bias=0.1 | sustrip > epsilon.bin && suplane nt=128 ntr=16 npl=1 dt=0.004 | sumiggbzoan a3333file=a3333.bin epsilonfile=epsilon.bin nx=16 nz=16 dz=10 dx=10 dt=0.004 fmin=8 fmax=40 amin=-30 amax=45 bwh=80 verbose=1 > out.su

programs.license_note: Credits state that Tariq Alkhalifah based the anisotropic implementation on Dave Hale's MIGGBZO.

programs.name: sumigprefd
programs.purpose: Depth-migrate common-shot prestack data using finite-difference wavefield extrapolation.

params.name: vfile
params.description: Native-float velocity file indexed as v[depth][horizontal position].

params.name: nxshot
params.description: Number of shot gathers to migrate.

params.name: f1
params.description: First frequency-window corner; the selfdoc says 5.

params.name: f2
params.description: Second frequency-window corner; the selfdoc says 10.

params.name: dt
params.default: computed: header dt in seconds, or 0.004 if unset

params.name: dx
params.default: computed: header d2, or 1.0 if unset
params.description: Horizontal sampling interval; despite the selfdoc, it is not mandatory.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Ricker generation, FFTs, frequency tapers, ordered shot/frequency accumulation and repeated complex tridiagonal solves depend on float rounding and transcendental math. Unsupported dip values leave coefficients uninitialized; too-small apertures access outside the finite-difference arrays, and coincident frequency bins can cause divisions by zero. Trace placement and shot grouping depend on the code's delayed header updates.
programs.difficulty_reason: Prestack migration propagates source and receiver wavefields through repeated finite-difference solves over shots and depths.

test_cases.description: Migrate one shot with a constant velocity and increasing receiver coordinates.
test_cases.command: sunull nt=16 ntr=16 | sugain bias=1500 | sustrip > vel.bin && suplane nt=128 ntr=16 dt=0.004 | suchw key1=gx key2=tracl a=-10 b=10 | sumigprefd vfile=vel.bin nxo=16 nxshot=1 nz=16 dz=10 dx=10 dt=0.004 > out.su

test_cases.description: Exercise the multistep dip approximation and explicit frequency window.
test_cases.command: sunull nt=16 ntr=16 | sugain bias=1800 | sustrip > vel.bin && suplane nt=128 ntr=16 npl=1 dt=0.004 | suchw key1=gx key2=tracl a=-10 b=10 | sumigprefd vfile=vel.bin nxo=16 nxshot=1 nz=16 dz=10 dx=10 dt=0.004 dip=80 fmax=30 f1=4 f2=12 f3=35 f4=55 lpad=4 rpad=4 verbose=1 > out.su
